sources.IND42: Auchinleck, operations despatch, London Gazette 38177: the 10th and 29th Brigades of 5th Indian Division occupied frontier positions at the beginning of May 1942 and later formed a mobile infantry reserve for Gazala. The 1 May game date, Matruh entry and 6,000 men are estimates. https://www.ibiblio.org/hyperwar/UN/UK/LondonGazette/38177.pdf

name: Gazala preparation: 9 February–25 May 1942 (linked research)

aim.cw: Build a defensible line around Gazala, Bir Hakeim and Tobruk, maintain a mobile reserve and secure supply. A different forward line remains possible if the played campaign supports it.
aim.axis: Restore the mobile force and supply, contest Cyrenaica, and prepare an attack on the Commonwealth position without sacrificing the route from the west.

about: A long linked strategic preparation chapter, not a historical deployment snapshot. The real Gazala line developed after the January counteroffensive and the Axis attack began 26 May. 50th Division and an aggregate 5th Indian Division counter are added with estimated field dates, strengths and entry points; Trieste already arrived during the 1941 preparation. No minefield or repair programme is scripted. Both sides may manoeuvre, attack or dig in during the preparation. The checker-owned places are placeholders; the played position is retained.
